slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can the product be purchased and sold within the same month, or must purchases be completed before any sales can occur in that month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about purchase and sale timing within the same month, and the simulator confirmed purchases occur at the beginning of the month and can be sold that same month.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only listed P1 hidden slot was explicitly resolved before READY_TO_MODEL, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions and explicitly resolved the key purchase-timing hidden slot before presenting the model.
